title: Contextual sample-hinting and alert enrichment pipeline
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a lightweight pipeline that augments traces, metrics, and logs with 'sample hints' and contextual tokens so downstream anomaly detectors and burn-rate alerts can (1) trigger fewer false positives, (2) page with richer context, and (3) surface correlated root-cause signals. This work spans trace-hook updates, a metrics/log enrichment stage, a small stateful service for short-lived context joins, and dashboard/alert rule changes for latency/error SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: Tracing hooks emit sample_hint and correlation_id for >=95% of backend spans at <1ms extra latency
Enrichment service joins traces+metrics+logs for a 30s sliding window and attaches context tags to metrics emitted to our metric pipeline
Burn-rate alert rules using enriched metrics reduce noisy pages by >=40% in baseline A/B test
Playbook pages include enriched context fields and an example prefilled PagerDuty message
tasks: Instrument lightweight trace-hook change (tracing-agent) to add sample_hint tokens
Implement enrichment service (k8s, stateful, 128MB mem target) for short lived joins
Add pipeline transform to metrics aggregator for context tags
Create Grafana SLO dashboards showing enriched vs baseline metrics
Update burn-rate alert rules and paging policy to prefer enriched-signal channels
Run 2-week canary on subset of traffic and measure paging delta
